title: PaperStats
description: Structured numerical record for a single research paper. Written by research-paper-summarizer alongside the markdown summary; consumed by research-accuracy-verifier at Stage 6 (numerical sanity) via cat substitution. Validated by scripts/validate_stats.py against this schema (Stage 1) plus rule predicates Q5/R5 from skills/shared/references/prose_standards_thresholds.yaml (Stage 2).

paper_id.description: Stable identifier for this paper. Prefer DOI (with or without https://doi.org/ prefix); fall back to PMID, PMCID, or a kebab-case slug derived from first-author + year + short-title when no persistent identifier is available. MUST match source_meta.json paper_id.

source_path.description: Absolute or repo-relative path to the resolved full-text source (PDF, markitdown output, or PMC XML). Null when only a DOI/PMID was provided and full-text retrieval was deferred.

extracted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of stats extraction. Lets the verifier detect stale stats files when the source paper has been re-summarized.

stats.description: Every numeric value preserved from the source paper. Q5 (numerical_consistency) requires that each entry's value/unit pair appears verbatim in the source.

claim_id.description: Stable per-paper claim identifier. Format C-NN (zero-padded 2-4 digits). Stable across re-runs of the same paper so that downstream verifier evidence pinning survives re-summarization.

value.description: The numeric value as it appears in the source. Strings allowed for inequality forms (e.g., '<0.001', '>=120'), exponential notation passed through verbatim, or composite ratios. Plain numerals SHOULD be JSON numbers.

unit.description: Unit string preserved from the source verbatim ('mg/kg', '%', 'ng/mL', 'µm', 'p-value', 'count', 'fold'). Null only when the value is intrinsically unitless (e.g., a count of patients reported without 'patients' or 'n =' label — rare).

context.description: Short surrounding context (≤280 chars) that disambiguates the value. Quotes the source clause minimally; not a full sentence dump.

source_location.description: Where in the source the value appears: 'Abstract', 'Results §3.2', 'Table 1', 'Figure 4 legend', 'Methods §2.1', etc. Used by the verifier when emitting evidence references.

verbatim.description: Q5 self-attestation: true iff value+unit appear in the source exactly as recorded (no rounding, no unit conversion). MUST be true for compliant stats; false entries are tolerated only when explicit conversion notes are provided in `notes`.

stat_type.description: Optional categorical tag. Mirrors utils.schemas.StatisticType. `null` is listed in the enum (alongside the type union) because Draft-07 applies `enum` to all instances regardless of declared type — omitting null from the enum would forbid null even when the type union permits it. Lets validators apply type-specific predicates (e.g., p-values must obey Q2 reporting rules).

notes.description: Optional free-text rationale, used when verbatim=false to explain the conversion or normalization performed. Keep under 280 chars.

preserved_numerics_count.description: Equals len(stats). Cross-check field — validate_stats.py errors if it disagrees with the array length.

Q5.description: Q5 (numerical_consistency, CRITICAL): every stats[] entry has verbatim=true and a non-empty source_location. 'unknown' is reserved for partial extractions where the rule could not be evaluated.

R5.description: R5 (numerical_consistency_full, CRITICAL): no two stats[] entries share a claim_id with conflicting value/unit pairs (cross-section reconciliation). 'unknown' is reserved for partial extractions.

extraction_meta.description: Optional provenance block. Recommended in fork mode so the verifier can inspect extraction conditions without reading the full markdown summary.

extractor_version.description: Semver of the extract_statistics.py script that produced this file.
